title: Find the diagnosis and age of the oldest female patient who has both an abn
question: Find the diagnosis and age of the oldest female patient who has both an abnormally high platelet count (PLT > 400) and the highest IgA level within its normal range (80–500).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_064" AS diagnosis,
       T2."XCL_016" AS age
FROM "Patient" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Laboratory" AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_027" > 400
  AND T2."XCL_043" BETWEEN 80 AND 500
ORDER BY T2."XCL_016" DESC, T2."XCL_043" DESC
LIMIT 1
